Forks and spoons with hammered textures are displayed on light wood. Pliers and saws with red and black handles follow, then high-end mechanical wrenches. The background remains consistent with an exhibition or store setting. (3) The man holds a sign indicating 'Tsubame-Sanjo' with station details. The scene then cuts to an electronic display on a train, followed by wide shots of a crowded indoor exhibition hall at Taipei Songshan. People are gathered around long tables looking at exhibits. (4) Outdoor event scenes under a translucent canopy. The man in blue speaks into a microphone on a stage. Later, indoor scenes show a panel discussion with three men and people interacting with products. The camera moves through a long, busy hallway packed with visitors. (5) The narrator speaks directly to the camera in a brightly lit corridor with many passers-by in the background. A final quick cut shows the man with a woman in a more casual, indoor setting, ending with a specific text overlay.
